name: Chunk Save Fix: Modern Port
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: okipiak
description: Fixes MC-224729, where partially generated chunks are not saved under certain conditions, leading to broken terrain features. This is an unofficial port of the original Chunk Save Fix mod for modern Minecraft versions.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
